entities.title: SimHost's GDScript interface
entities.summary: The method names, the string names of presses, screens and modes, and the Dictionary keys the scenes read.
consumers: The Godot scenes: game.gd, space.gd, hud.gd, the panels in ui/, script_runner.gd
guarantees: Presses by name: start, launch, hyperspace, galaxy_drive, unarm_missile, arm_missile, fire_missile, area_blast, escape_pod, in_system_jump, ecm, auto_dock, pause, resume, quit, toggle_auto_centre, toggle_damping
Screens by name: space, galaxy, local, system, status, market, inventory, equipment
Modes by name: title, docked, tunnel_launch, tunnel_dock, tunnel_jump, tunnel_misjump, tunnel_galactic, flight, dying, escape
save_pilot answers saved, not_docked or no_name; load_pilot an empty string, not_title, not_found or rejected
Positions in Godot metres (0.2 m a sim unit), x right, y up, the sim's forward z as −Z
entities.compatibility: GDScript is not compiled against it: a renamed method or key fails only when the scene runs. Rebuild the library (cargo build) after a change; the smoke test (--script=@smoke) exercises the main paths.

entities.title: SimHost's signals
entities.summary: ticked(tick) after every tick, mount_selected(mount), and sim_event(kind, data) for every event of the tick, in order.
consumers: game.gd, space.gd, hub.gd and its pages, which connect to the signals
guarantees: One sim_event per Event of the tick, in the tick's order, before ticked
kind is a lower-case name (mode, paused, hyperspace, laser_fired, bought …) and data a Dictionary of that event's fields
entities.compatibility: Changes with FlyInSystem's Event and SimHost::describe; the scenes match on kind and read data by key.

entities.title: Held actions in the input map
entities.summary: SimHost samples seven input-map actions at every tick: dive, climb, roll_left, roll_right, speed_up, slow_down and fire.
consumers: project.godot's [input] section, which must define them
guarantees: The names are RULES D.5's action names, sampled once per tick
